name: Sagar Bera
title: Backend & DevOps Engineer
headline: Backend and DevOps engineer. I build and run the systems behind products used by 50,000+ creators.
bio: I'm a backend and DevOps engineer at Scribble Network. I joined as the first backend hire and work closely with the CTO, owning backend and infrastructure end to end: [[NestJS]] APIs, [[PostgreSQL]] schemas, and the [[Docker]], [[CI/CD]], and cloud setup that keeps them running. I helped move our core data from MongoDB to PostgreSQL, and what I've built now serves [[50,000+]] creators and helped one client grow AI citation share from [[2% to 20%]] in 3 months. Before that, at BuidlersTribe, I rebuilt a Drupal site on [[MERN]] and sped up feature delivery by [[30%]].

experience.summary: Joined as the first backend hire and grew with the company. I own backend, database design, and infrastructure across Scribble's creator, brand, and ad products on [[AWS]] and [[GCP]], working closely with the CTO on key architecture decisions.
highlights: Executed the CTO-directed move of core data from MongoDB to [[PostgreSQL]] for cleaner structure and faster queries, which made new features far easier to add.
Partnered with the CTO to migrate production from [[AWS]] to [[GCP]] for better cost efficiency, keeping the product live throughout.
Automated production deployments with GitHub Actions and set up log monitoring with Loki and Grafana.
Resolved a late-night production outage in [[5–10 minutes]] (versus an estimated 1–2 hours) by using Cursor AI to speed up diagnosis and the fix.

Built Scribble for Creators ([[50,000+]] creators, [[$500,000+]] paid across [[800+]] campaigns), Scribble for Brands (Listed in Product Hunt's [[Top 3 AI Products of the Week]]), and Kili ([[250+]] daily active developers), built in [[4 days]] with Cursor AI: a public API server, an internal server, two developer integration packages, and the UI.
Built auth system from scratch: [[Magic links]] plus [[Google]] and [[X (Twitter)]] login.
Built [[Microservices]] for notifications and incoming webhooks, and a faucet that handles crypto payouts.
Built a crypto native Telegram bot that lets anyone [[send crypto]] using just a Telegram username.
Built Rabots: one-click bots that put funds into [[DeFi yield]], so beginners skip the usual research and multi-step setup.
Wrote Smart Contracts in [[Solidity]] for EVM and [[Move]] for Sui to handle prediction markets and automated trading.
Use Cursor and Claude Code every day to ship faster.

experience.summary: Rebuilt BuidlersTribe's Drupal (LAMP) website as a [[MERN]] app, trading Drupal's limited built-in settings for a codebase we could fully customize.
highlights: Led the Drupal to MERN migration, which made the product easy to customize and sped up feature delivery by [[30%]].
Used the new stack to rebrand with a cleaner, easier-to-use interface, which grew product traction and pushed daily active users up.
Deployed and ran the app on [[AWS]] behind Nginx.
